title: An omitted affine constant inherits a falsely decaying Lerch atom tail
prior_issue: Affine wrapper was not admitted; report characterized a coverage failure, not a false theorem.
new_mechanism: Direct affine integration charges beta to the atom bound constant without joining weight zero with the atom remainder exponent.
difference: New implementation can accept the wrapper but report a false order and absolute bound at a nonpositive cutoff.
not_new_and_excluded: Term-goal handling and affine cancellation counting
Existing modulus, certificate, Mathics-proof and budget findings
